name: ai-privacy-gateway
description: 本机 AI 请求检测、替换和审计桌面应用
author: Privacy Gateway Contributors

scripts.test: tsx --test tests/privacy.test.ts tests/gateway.test.ts tests/workbuddy.test.ts tests/rules.test.ts tests/native-inspection.test.ts tests/rule-settings.test.ts tests/protection.test.ts tests/certificate-store.test.ts tests/uninstall.test.ts
scripts.pack: npm run prepare:native && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:native && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/prepare-native.mjs win-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
